I am a 40-year-old farmer in SNNP with no schooling, and this 0.14-hectare plot is my main maize field. I have learned over the years that using improved seed and some fertilizer helps me get a better harvest to feed my family and maybe sell a little. I will put manure on the plot because I have livestock, and I will also buy some chemical fertilizer from the cooperative since the government helps make it available. But because the plot is small and I have my children to help, we can weed and harvest by hand without hiring workers, and we depend on the rains since there is no irrigation here.
